prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash-type injury. The mechanism and force of impact are in keeping with the reported symptoms. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Care was delivered over fifteen visits and followed a typical conservative course of manual therapy, home exercise instruction, and analgesic management. Frequency of visits decreased as symptoms improved and the patient was discharged to self-directed care. Cervical imaging was unremarkable, and orthopedic and neurological screening examinations were within normal limits. Clinical findings rely largely on the patient's self-reported pain levels and functional limitations. During record review, one service entry for a single visit appeared twice on the billing statement. The provider confirmed that the second entry was a duplicate and has submitted a correction.
